strings.ITEMROULETTE_ARTIFACT_DESC:
Enables the ItemRoulette overhaul for this run: on-screen item reel, replaced chests and drops, casino roulette, Life Bet, and chaos events.

strings.ITEMROULETTE_MOD_DESC: Gameplay overhaul for Risk of Rain 2: CS2-style item reel roulette, Chaos event system, European Casino with Life Bet, and full server-authoritative multiplayer.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_LANGUAGE_DESC: Language for mod UI, notifications, and events (Auto / English / Russian). Auto detects game language.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_REQUIREARTIFACT_DESC: ItemRoulette mechanics only activate when the Artifact of the Roulette is chosen in the lobby or run rules. If disabled, ItemRoulette is always active.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_PAUSEGAMEWHILEOPEN_D: Whether to pause singleplayer game while roulette window is open (always real-time in multiplayer).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SPINDURATION_DESC: Duration of roulette roll animation in seconds.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_POSTSPINDISPLAYDURAT: Duration the roulette window remains visible after roll completion before auto-hiding in seconds.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_AUTOSPINHOLDDURATION: Key hold duration in seconds required to toggle auto-spin mode on or off.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_AUTOSPINDELAY_DESC: Delay in seconds between finished spin and next roll in auto-spin mode.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SHOWCHANCEWIDGETINUI: Displays current colored Chaos odds widget (Good / Bad %) in the roulette UI.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOTKEY_DESC: Hotkey to open and spin standard item roulette (default B).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VOIDSPINHOTKEY_DESC: Hotkey for Void item roulette. Single click to spin, hold 1.0s to decline.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_AUTOSPINHOTKEY_DESC: Hotkey to toggle continuous auto-spin mode (hold to toggle ON/OFF).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VOIDREROLLHOTKEY_DES: Hotkey to reroll a Void item in choice window (default R).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ADMINMENUHOTKEY_DESC: Hotkey to open Chaos test admin menu (default F7).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_CASINOTOGGLEHOTKEY_D: Hotkey to open and close Casino Roulette menu.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLECHESTSPAWNS_D: Disables spawning chests, printers, and multishops on stages (leaves barrels, drones, and shrines).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLECHESTDROPS_DE: Blocks item drops from chests and shop terminals if opened unexpectedly.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLEBOSSDROPS_DES: Blocks item drops from stage teleporter bosses.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLECHANCESHRINES: Disables Shrines of Chance from spawning on stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLEFABRICATORS_D: Disables Fabricators and Adaptive Chests from spawning.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEVOIDCHESTS_DES: Allows Void Cradles and Void Potentials to spawn on stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLELUNARCHESTS_DE: Allows Lunar Pods (Lunar Chests) to spawn on stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_BASECOST_DESC: Base spin cost (equivalent to small chest on stage 1).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_COSTSCALINGMODE_DESC: Price scaling formula per spin on stage: LinearPercent, Exponential, or Linear.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ROLLCOSTINCREASEPERC: Percent added to base cost per paid spin on current stage (+20% by default).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SCALEWITHTIME_DESC: Scales base roll cost with run elapsed time and dynamic game difficulty coefficient.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_TIMECOSTSCALINGMULTI: Multiplier for time-based cost scaling rate (1.0 = standard, 0.5 = half speed).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SCALEWITHSTAGE_DESC: Scales base cost by stage count (+X% per stage completed).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_STAGECOSTINCREASEPER: Percent added to base cost per completed stage (+10% by default).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_EXPONENTIALCOSTMULTI: Cost multiplier per spin on stage in Exponential mode (1.20 = +20% per roll).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_LINEARCOSTINCREMENT_: Fixed gold increment added to base cost per roll in Linear mode.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_RESETCOSTONNEWSTAGE_: Resets spin counter and stage cost markups upon transitioning to next stage.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_FREEROLLSPERSTAGEBAS: Base number of free spins awarded at the beginning of each stage.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_FREEROLLSONTELEPORTE: Free Boss Reward spins (85% Green / 5% Red / 10% Boss) awarded upon 100% charging the stage teleporter.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_FREEROLLSPERSALESTAR: Free spins granted at stage start per Sale Star in inventory (used only if Sale Star Rework is disabled).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLESALESTARREWORK: Enables reworked Sale Star mechanic: mutually exclusive choice to duplicate chest spins OR grant bonus boss spins.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SALESTARDUPLICATECHE: Duplicates awarded roulette spins when Sale Star triggers on opening a chest.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SALESTARBOSSREWARDSP: Free Boss pool spins awarded upon boss defeat/teleporter charge with 1 active Sale Star.
Sale Star Boss Reward Spins (Per Stack)
Additional free Boss pool spins awarded per subsequent Sale Star stack upon boss defeat.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SALESTARBOSSTRIGGERT: When Sale Star triggers on boss: OnTeleporterCharged (100% teleporter charged) or OnAllBossesDefeated (instantly when all bosses die).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SALESTARQUALITYBOSS_: Quality Sale Star Boss Quality Spins
When Quality Sale Stars trigger on the boss, grant guaranteed Quality spins (Free Quality Rolls) in addition to Boss item spins.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SALESTARQUALITYMINTI: Spins granted by Quality Sale Stars guarantee a minimum item quality equal to the star's tier (e.g. Epic star guarantees at least Epic quality).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_FREEROLLSPERMOUNTAIN: Additional free spins awarded per activated Mountain Shrine upon boss defeat.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_MOUNTAINSHRINEBOSSRO: Mountain Shrine Grants Boss Reward Spins
Spins from Mountain Shrines are awarded from the Boss Reward pool (85% Green / 5% Red / 10% Boss) instead of regular free spins.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_BOSSREWARDWEIGHTUNCO: Weight of Uncommon (Green) items in the Boss Reward pool (default 85%).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_BOSSREWARDWEIGHTLEGE: Weight of Legendary (Red) items in the Boss Reward pool (default 5%).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_BOSSREWARDWEIGHTBOSS: Weight of Boss (Yellow) items in the Boss Reward pool (default 10%).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLECHANCEDOLLSUPP: Enables Chance Doll support: chance to upgrade rolled item tier (white->green->red).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_CHANCEDOLLBASECHANCE: Base percent chance to upgrade item tier with 1st Chance Doll stack (default 5%).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_CHANCEDOLLSTACKCHANC: Additional upgrade percent chance per subsequent stack of Chance Doll.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_GOLDCHESTREWARDALLPL: Awards 1 free red-only spin to all players upon opening a Gold/Legendary chest.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_PREPLACEDCHESTREWARD: Awards 1 free standard spin to all players upon opening preplaced/found chests.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SECRETBOSSREWARDALLP: Awards 1 free red spin to all players upon defeating secret boss (Alloy Worship Unit).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_QUALITYCHESTREWARDAL: Grants free roll on opening Quality Chest to entire team (true) or opener only (false).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEVOIDCORRUPTCHO: Prompts player with confirmation choice on new Void or Lunar item drop: Accept or Decline.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VOIDDECLINECOSTMODE_: Payment method for declining item: LunarCoins or MaxHealthPenalty (stacking max HP curse).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VOIDDECLINELUNARCOIN: Cost in Lunar Coins to cleanse/decline an item in LunarCoins mode.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VOIDDECLINEMAXHEALTH: Percent max HP lost per item decline until stage end in MaxHealthPenalty mode.
Maximum cumulative percentage penalty cap for max health loss from declines.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEVOIDREROLL_DES: Enables ability to reroll a rolled Void item in choice window for Lunar Coins.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VOIDREROLLLUNARCOINS: Cost in Lunar Coins per Void item reroll.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VOIDREROLLMAXPERITEM: Maximum number of rerolls permitted per rolled Void item.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_WEIGHTCOMMON_DESC: Drop weight for Common (White / Tier 1) items.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_WEIGHTUNCOMMON_DESC: Drop weight for Uncommon (Green / Tier 2) items.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_WEIGHTLEGENDARY_DESC: Drop weight for Legendary (Red / Tier 3) items.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_INCLUDELUNAR_DESC: Whether to include Lunar items in the standard roulette pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_WEIGHTLUNAR_DESC: Drop weight for Lunar (Blue) items when included.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_INCLUDEVOID_DESC: Whether to include Void items in the standard roulette pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_WEIGHTVOID_DESC: Drop weight for Void (Purple) items when included.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_INCLUDELUNAREQUIPMEN: Includes Lunar active equipment in the roulette's lunar item pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_LUNARCUSTOMBLACKLIST: Comma-separated list of item tokens/internal names excluded from Lunar rolls.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEZETASPECTSINTE: Enables ZetAspects mod integration: awards aspects as passive items instead of equipment.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_INCLUDEZETASPECTSINP: Includes ZetAspects elite aspects in roulette pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEQUALITYINTEGRA: Enables integration with Quality mod (Goorakh-Quality) to upgrade item tiers.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_QUALITYROLLCHANCEMUL: Multiplier applied to base chance of upgrading an item's quality on roulette roll.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWQUALITYCHESTSPA: Allows Quality Chests (QualityChest1/2) to spawn on stages (disabled = suppressed).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLECHAOSQUALITYIN: Determines whether player's total Chaos percentage boosts Quality chance.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_CHAOSQUALITYINFLUENC: Quality chance bonus per 1% total Chaos in % (+5% quality chance at 100% Chaos).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLECHAOSSYSTEM_DE: Enables Chaos System with dual roll effects (Item + Event).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_BASEGOODEVENTCHANCE_: Base percentage chance for a Positive Chaos Event to trigger.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_BASEBADEVENTCHANCE_D: Base percentage chance for a Negative Chaos Event to trigger.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_LUNARVOIDCHANCEPERIT: Bonus added to both Good and Bad chances per Blue/Purple item in inventory (% per item).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_MAXLUNARVOIDBONUSCAP: Maximum cumulative percentage bonus cap from Blue and Purple items.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_CLOVERBONUSPERITEM_D: Bonus added to Positive event chance per 57 Leaf Clover in inventory (% per item).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_PURITYPENALTYPERITEM: Increase added to Negative event chance per Purity in inventory (% per item).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_LOWGRAVITYVALUE_DESC: Vertical gravity applied during 'Moon Gravity x2' event (-7.5 vs Moon -15, normal -30).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_TIERODDSBOOSTMULTIPL: Multiplier for Green, Red, and Boss item odds during 'Rarity Blessing' buff.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_TIERODDSPENALTYMULTI: Multiplier for Green, Red, and Boss item odds during 'Commoner's Curse' debuff.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEADMINPANEL_DES: Enables Chaos effect test admin panel (F7).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLECASINOROULETTE: Enable or disable European Casino Roulette mode (gold, items and life bets).

strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTDOUBLEGOLD: Allow 'Gold Jackpot' event: Doubles current gold balance.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTNEXTSTAGEF: Allow 'Fortune Advance' event: Awards +3 free rolls on next stage.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTKILLENEMIE: Allow 'Orbital Sweep' event: Instantly obliterates 30% of monsters on map.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTALLYMIRROR: Allow 'Ally Mirror' event: Copies an item of equivalent tier from a teammate.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTHEAL50PERC: Allow 'Healing Grace' event: Heals player for 50% max HP.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTFRIENDLYCL: Allow 'Phantom Ally' event: Summons an allied doppelganger clone.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTELEMENTALA: Allow 'Elite Essence' event: Drops a random elite aspect.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTTIERODDSBO: Allow 'Rarity Blessing' event: Temporarily boosts odds of higher item tiers.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTALLIEDDRON: Allow 'Drone Squadron' event: Summons an allied strike squad of combat drones.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTFORGEANOMA: Allow 'Forge Anomaly' event: Boosts item quality tier by +1 (requires Quality mod).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTLOSEGOLD30: Allow 'Bandit Ambush' event: Steals 30% of current gold balance.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTCOSTINCREA: Allow 'Inflation' event: Increases spin cost by +10% until stage end.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTRANDOMLUNA: Allow 'Void Temptation' event: Forcefully grants a random Lunar or Void item.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTTIERDOWNSA: Allow 'Natural Sacrifice' event: Converts a random item into a lower tier.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTNEXTSPINFI: Allow 'All or Nothing' event: Sets next spin odds to 50% Good / 50% Bad event.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTHALLOWEDCU: Allow 'Void Leech' event: Applies temporary curse stack reducing max health.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTDAMAGEHP30: Allow 'Blood Tax' event: Damages player for 30% of current HP.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTCONVERTHPT: Allow 'Fragile Aegis' event: Converts a portion of HP into temporary barrier.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTENEMYITEMM: Allow 'Monster Mimic' event: Grants monsters on stage a copy of player's item.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTEVILCLONE_: Allow 'Evil Doppelganger' event: Spawns hostile clone with player's items.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTRANDOMSTAG: Allow 'Stage Anomaly' event: Temporarily activates a random trial artifact for stage.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTCOMBATSHRI: Allow 'Shrine Wrath' event: Spawns hostile elite monsters (2x Combat Shrine effect).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTLOWGRAVITY: Allow 'Moon Gravity' event: Drastically reduces gravity until stage end.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTTIERODDSPE: Allow 'Commoner's Curse' event: Temporarily lowers higher tier item drop odds.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTHOSTILEDRO: Allow 'Drone Uprising' event: Spawns an aggressive squad of hostile drones.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONEDAMAGEMU: Damage dealt multiplier for hostile drones (default 0.10 = 10%).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONEHEALTHMU: Max health multiplier for hostile drones (default 0.10 = 10%).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONESPAWNDIS: Spawn distance of hostile drones from the player in meters (default 15m).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONESTUNDURA: Stun and reboot duration of drones before engaging in combat in seconds (default 10s).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONEGUNNERCO: Number of Gunner Drones in squad (0 to exclude from pool, default 4).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONEFLAMECOU: Number of Flame Drones in squad (0 to exclude from pool, default 3).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONEMISSILEC: Number of Missile Drones in squad (0 to exclude from pool, default 2).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONEMEGACOUN: Number of TC-280 Mega Drones in squad (0 to exclude from pool, default 1).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEHOSTILEDRONELI: Enable lifespan timer for hostile drones (they self-destruct once expired).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_HOSTILEDRONELIFETIME: Lifespan of hostile drones before self-destructing in seconds (default 30s).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWEVENTVOIDCORROS: Allow 'Void Corrosion' event: Decreases an item's quality tier by 1 (requires Quality mod).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTSPITE_D: Allow Artifact of Spite: Enemies drop bombs on death.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTWARFARE: Allow Artifact of Warfare: Greater monster speed if mod present.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTHONOR_D: Allow Artifact of Honor: All enemies spawn as elites.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTCHAOS_D: Allow Artifact of Chaos: Friendly fire (MP only).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTDISSONA: Allow Artifact of Dissonance: Monsters spawn outside usual stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTKIN_DES: Allow Artifact of Kin: Single monster type per stage (disabled by default).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTSWARMS_: Allow Artifact of Swarms: Doubles monster count, halves max HP.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTFRAILTY: Allow Artifact of Frailty: Fall damage is lethal.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTSOUL_DE: Allow Artifact of Soul: Wisps spawn on enemy death.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTGLASS_D: Allow Artifact of Glass: 500% damage, 10% health.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTEVOLUTI: Allow Artifact of Evolution: Monsters gain items between stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTVENGEAN: Allow Artifact of Vengeance: Shadow clone of player spawns every 10 min.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTMETAMOR: Allow Artifact of Metamorphosis: Random survivor each stage.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTENIGMA_: Allow Artifact of Enigma: Random equipment on activation.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTSACRIFI: Allow Artifact of Sacrifice: Chests don't spawn, items drop from enemies.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTCOMMAND: Allow Artifact of Command: Choose items from menu.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTDEATH_D: Allow Artifact of Death: One player death wipes team.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTDEVOTIO: Allow Artifact of Devotion: Lemurian eggs replace drones.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTDELUSIO: Allow Artifact of Delusion: Reset chests on teleporter event.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWARTIFACTREBIRTH: Allow Artifact of Rebirth: Keep item for next run.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWMODDEDARTIFACTS: Automatically includes any third-party modded artifacts in pool via ArtifactCatalog.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ARTIFACTCUSTOMBLACKL: Comma-separated list of artifact internal names/tokens excluded from event rolls.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLEMULTISHOPS_DE: Disables triple shop terminals with passive items from spawning on stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLEEQUIPMENTCHES: Disables equipment barrels and chests from spawning on stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_DISABLEEQUIPMENTMULT: Disables triple equipment shop terminals with active equipment from spawning on stages.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ZETASPECTSPOOLMODE_D: How aspects are placed in roulette: DedicatedTier (own tier and weight), BossTier (merged with boss items), LegendaryTier (merged with legendaries), or AutoByModTier.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_WEIGHTZETASPECTS_DES: Relative weight of elite aspects in paid roulette when using DedicatedTier mode (default 0.5).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ZETASPECTSCUSTOMBLAC: Comma-separated list of aspect names to exclude from the roulette pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ZETASPECTSALLOWVOIDA: Whether the Void aspect can drop in the aspect pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ZETASPECTSALLOWLUNAR: Whether the Lunar/Perfected aspect can drop in the aspect pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_EQUIPMENTCHESTREWARD: Awards 1 free equipment spin to all players upon opening an equipment barrel/chest.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_LUNARCHESTREWARDALLP: Awards 1 free Lunar spin to all players upon opening a Lunar Pod.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_INCLUDEVANILLAASPECT: Whether to include standard elite monster aspects in roulette when ZetAspects is not active.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VANILLAASPECTSPOOLMO: How vanilla aspects appear in roulette: DedicatedTier (own tier and weight), BossTier (merged with boss items), EquipmentPool (equipment spins only), or Disabled.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_WEIGHTVANILLAASPECTS: Relative drop weight of vanilla aspects in paid roulette when using DedicatedTier mode.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_INCLUDEASPECTSINEQUI: Allows elite aspects to drop when rolling equipment chests.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ASPECTDROPRATEINEQUI: Percentage chance to receive an elite aspect instead of normal equipment in equipment roll (default 5%).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTFIRE_DESC: Allows Fire Aspect (Ifrit) elite aspect (AffixRed) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTLIGHTNING: Allows Lightning Aspect (Overloading) elite aspect (AffixBlue) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTICE_DESC: Allows Ice Aspect (Glacial) elite aspect (AffixWhite) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTMALACHITE: Allows Malachite Aspect (Poison) elite aspect (AffixPoison) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTCELESTINE: Allows Celestine Aspect (Ghost) elite aspect (AffixHaunted) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTMENDING_D: Allows Mending Aspect (Earth) elite aspect (EliteEarthEquipment) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTPERFECTED: Allows Perfected Aspect (Lunar) elite aspect (AffixLunar) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ALLOWASPECTVOID_DESC: Allows Void Aspect elite aspect (EliteVoidEquipment) to drop in roulette.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_VANILLAASPECTSCUSTOM: Comma-separated list of aspect internal names/tokens excluded from pool.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEEQUIPMENTDROPC: Prompts player with choice on equipment drop: Take (equip) or Drop to floor.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ZETASPECTSDUPLICATEE: ZetAspects balance: when an aspect drops from a Chaos event (Elemental Aspect), if the player already has at least one aspect, grants a random duplicate of an already owned aspect.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLESOLITUDEMECHAN: Enable custom mechanic for Longstanding Solitude: free spins with increased rarity multiplier on level up.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SOLITUDEBASE_DESC: Base free spins awarded on level up for 1st stack of Longstanding Solitude.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SOLITUDEPERSTACK_DES: Additional free spins awarded on level up per additional stack.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SOLITUDEMULTBASE_DES: Base rarity odds multiplier bonus (+x0.20) for spins obtained from Longstanding Solitude.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SOLITUDEMULTPERSTACK: Additional rarity odds multiplier bonus (+x0.10) per additional stack.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_SOLITUDEREWARDALL_DE: Whether Longstanding Solitude level up spins are awarded to all players or only the item owner.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_ENABLEITEMDESCRIPTIO: Whether to append hints about ItemRoulette mechanics to item descriptions (Longstanding Solitude, Chance Doll, Sale Star, 57 Leaf Clover, Purity).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_UISCALE_DESC: Overall master scale multiplier for all mod UI elements (0.1 - 5.0, default 1.0). Scales the entire mod UI proportionally.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_UISCALEROULETTE_DESC: Scale multiplier for the item roulette and casino reel (0.1 - 5.0, default 1.0). Affects the top banner, hint pill, hold progress bar, and choice modal.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_UISCALEWINDOWS_DESC: Scale multiplier for draggable windows (0.1 - 5.0, default 1.0). Affects the casino betting table, run event journal, and chaos admin menu.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_UISCALETOASTS_DESC: Scale multiplier for toast notification cards (0.1 - 5.0, default 1.0) appearing in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
strings.ITEMROULETTE_CONFIG_NOTIFICATIONJOURNALH: Key to open and close the Run Event Log / Journal (default [J]).
strings.ITEMROULETTE_JOURNAL_EMPTY: No events recorded in current run yet.
